catala_a:
declaration scope Kirchensteuer:
  input est_mit_fb content money
  input konfession content integer
  input bundesland content integer
  internal satz content decimal
  output kist content money

scope Kirchensteuer:
  definition satz equals
    if (konfession = 0) or (konfession = 3) then 0.0
    else if (bundesland = 1) or (bundesland = 2) then 0.08
    else 0.09

  definition kist equals est_mit_fb * satz
catala_b:
declaration scope Kirchensteuer:
  input est_mit_fb content money
  input konfession content integer
  input bundesland content integer
  internal satz content decimal
  internal roh_kist content money
  output kist content money

scope Kirchensteuer:
  definition satz equals
    if konfession = 0 or konfession = 3 then 0.0
    else (if bundesland = 1 or bundesland = 2 then 0.08 else 0.09)
  definition roh_kist equals est_mit_fb * satz
  definition kist equals (Decimal.truncate of (roh_kist / $1.00)) * $1.00
